_meta.description: AC-wise general electors (male + female + third gender, including overseas/NRI electors, excluding service electors) from the ECI 'Index Card Assembly - 2023' for each of the 90 ACs, i.e. the electoral roll used at the Nov 2023 general election (poll on 7 Nov 2023 for 20 ACs and 17 Nov 2023 for 70 ACs; as_of per AC is its poll date). These are 2023 election figures, not the latest roll: AC-wise figures from the SIR 2025-26 final roll (published 21 Feb 2026, qualifying date 1 Jan 2026, state total 1,87,30,914 electors per the CEO Chhattisgarh press note of 21 Feb 2026) could not be located in a machine-readable or published AC-wise table. The CEO press note gives only district-wise totals, and the ECI voters-portal statutory reports are per-part downloads. Each published total equals male + female + third gender. Adding service electors reproduces the Index Card 'Total' (e.g. AC 1: 176,572 + 124 = 176,696).
